journal.text:
I read through the minbpe code this session to get oriented: lineage_bench.py (lines 1-107), minbpe/regex.py, base.py and basic.py, plus __init__.py and gpt4.py. I also searched for import lines and got 51 matching lines, to see how the modules depend on each other.

Nothing was measured. I made no edits, ran no sandbox evaluations, and the session ended without submitting a candidate. So I have no results to report and nothing for anyone to replay.

What I believe now is only structural, not tested. The package is small. base.py holds the shared tokenizer machinery, basic.py and regex.py are the two trainers, and gpt4.py wraps the regex one. The bench script is short enough to read fully, and I should anchor any change to what it actually times.

Next session I should run the bench unmodified first to get a baseline. Then I should pick one hot path in the merge or encode loop, change only that, and evaluate in the sandbox before submitting. Reading without measuring cost me this whole session.
